designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1964 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as wintering habitat for the dusky Canada goose in Oregon's Willamette Valley.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: William L. Finley National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Corvallis Advocate: William L. Finley NWR, "Established in 1964, the intention was to provide winter resting grounds for dusky Canada geese"
Federal Register, Feb. 17, 2012 (2012-03759): Willamette Valley refuges "were established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act"
